label: ISOLATED MOCK CAMPAIGN — not actual history
dmNarration: Water spills down into a broad rift. Ropes hang from stakes along its western edge, while the clack of shifted rubble rises from below. Figures work under the eye of a dark-clad supervisor.

The waterfall fills the rift with a steady roar, broken by the clacking work below. Ropes fastened to stakes on the western side offer a visible means of descent. From the edge, you can examine their condition and the figures beneath before committing to the drop.
question: Returning to the stair junction, you find a dry north corridor as well as the pool stream. It leads to a collapsed cavern: two bugbears dig in a deep rift, a third guards the rim, and a dark-clad overseer turns toward you. A western passage leaves the upper ledge. Do you speak, scout, or withdraw?
